Post 1
📈 ASX 200 hits a 100-day high, up 126.50pts or 1.40% to 9,145.80 — just 0.62% from a 52-week record. Tech and defence led the charge. The market is telling you risk appetite is back. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
IT surged +3.93%, Health Care +2.36%, Financials +1.93%. Utilities the lone red sector at -0.42%. When tech runs hardest and defensives lag, that's a risk-on rotation worth watching. #ASX #ausbiz #tech

Post 3
🔺 DroneShield up 14.60% to AUD 2.080, Electro Optic Systems +8.93% to AUD 7.560. Defence tech dominated the top of the board today. Two names, one theme. #ASX #ausbiz #defence

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 5,803.24/oz, Silver AUD 84.58/oz, Platinum AUD 2,448.96/oz. With AUD/USD at 0.7011, metals priced in local currency remain elevated. #ASX #gold #metals #ausbiz

Post 5
ASX sits 0.62% from its 52-week high. One more strong session closes that gap. Watch whether US tech holds overnight — if it does, new highs are on the table. Will the index break through this week? #ASX #ausbiz #markets
